ocrCorrection.derivation: Two independent published checks. (1) The report's own 16-tray mean total biomass is 371 g; the extracted values average 371.0 g only when tray 7 is 231 (with 451 the mean is 384.75 g). (2) The report's own edible biomass index for tray 7 is 16 %; 35.86 g seed / 231 g = 15.5 %, whereas 35.86 / 451 = 8.0 %. The printed STD of 96 g also matches only with 231.

sourceInconsistencies.explanation: Tray 9 totalPlants=216 is consistent with the report's published 16-tray plant mean (271) but NOT with its own published seeds/plant (14.2) and mass/plant (0.34), which require 326 plants. The document is internally contradictory for this row. Primary measurements are retained; the two derived columns are excluded from validation and flagged.

Published EBI 37% vs 38.6% recomputed (146.65/380). A 1.6 pp discrepancy. Total biomass 380 g is retained because it reproduces the published 371 g mean exactly; the EBI figure appears mis-rounded in the source.
Published %root 22.0 vs 22.95 recomputed (4.82/21). A 0.95 pp discrepancy in the oldest destructive harvest; dry mass 21 g is retained because it reproduces the published DW/plant of 0.07 g.

perM3HeightAssumption.note: The same report converts per-m2 to per-m3 with two different assumed canopy heights (0.526 m in Table 7, 0.385 m in Table 10). Both observed factors are validated as published and the inconsistency is recorded rather than reconciled.

trayArea.note: Authors state 0.24 m2; their seed-mass-per-m2 column implies ~0.238 m2. The discrepancy is recorded rather than smoothed over.

waterBalance.caveat: Condensate is the authors' proxy for transpiration, not a closed water-recovery test: the chamber leaked 20-40 %/day in this phase and the added-water total includes plumbing losses.
